corrections.why: a projection, not an observed age: AnAge's 102 years is the projected maximum of Voituron et al., Biology Letters 7:105, 2011, from survival in a laboratory population, which AnAge files as a wild maximum; carried here as a projection of unrecorded origin at grade C, so it is shown but not fitted (D-92 a)

the hand-checked table's 100 years is the same projection rounded, and its 68 is Voituron et al.'s mean adult lifespan in that laboratory population; neither is an observed maximum, so the record carries AnAge's figure for the projection instead
the hand-checked table's 25 g cites no source; AnAge and Amniote both give 8.73 g
